> **Classification:** Process Template | **Scope:** Required fields for every PR — no passive remaining risks (absorbed the former PR review standard doc, 2026-09-05, RC-520)

## What changed:
<!-- files + behavior -->

## What did not change:
<!-- explicitly list: model, fusion, histogram, card direction, thresholds -->

## Proof run:
<!-- commands + exit codes; paste actual output sections, not a summary -->

## CI failures:
<!-- hardening / pytest-full — both are required checks; a PR does not merge with either red -->

## Root-cause rows closed:
<!-- RC id + the evidence cell -->

## Root-cause rows opened / claims registered:
<!-- RC id or unproven_register.md row + due date -->

## Remaining risks:
<!-- each one: FIXED_IN_THIS_PR / VALIDATED_IN_THIS_PR / BLOCKED_BY_RTH_WITH_RUNNABLE_VALIDATION_HARNESS / ACCEPTED_WITH_EVIDENCE <cite>. A passive "known remaining risk" makes the PR not merge-ready. -->

## Review against the canonical standard:
<!-- governance/AGENT_OPERATING_PROCESS_V1.md §8 (fourteen requirements) is the review standard
     this PR is judged against. State the verdict — PASS / FAIL / NOT_PROVEN, per §8 item 14 —
     with the evidence for each required condition, not just a summary line. PASS requires every
     required condition proven; any demonstrated violation is FAIL regardless of what else
     passed; a required condition still missing proof is NOT_PROVEN. Do not state PASS while any
     required condition is FAIL or NOT_PROVEN. -->

## Merge:
<!-- AGENTS.md's "Standing merge authority": a development agent merges its own PR once the
     mission is fully proven (exact final HEAD, clean worktree, required CI green on that HEAD,
     no material FAIL or required NOT_PROVEN remaining, net repository quality improved, no
     unauthorized scope expansion) — no separate operator MERGE word needed for that case. State
     which applies here: merged under standing authority (say so, with the evidence above), or
     held for the operator's explicit word (say which of AGENTS.md's named exceptions applies —
     AUDIT ONLY / DO NOT MERGE, an operator halt word in force, a destructive production/data
     action, or a material unresolved policy decision with no engineering answer). -->
